LEASE FILE NUMBER L- a & b 7 DATE PREPARED PAGE 1 OF LEASE OF THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY Davidson County, Tennessee doing business as the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County herein referred to as Nashville Farmers Market and FM Entertainment ("Lessee") hereby agree as follows: 1, Leased Premises, in consideration of the rents and charges hereinafter provided, the mutual agreements contained herein, and subject to the terms and conditions hereinafter stated, the Nashville Farmers Market hereby leases to the Lessee and Lessee hereby leases from the Nashville Farmers Market the following spaces within the Nashville Farmers Market (“Premises”) at the time indicated below. SPACES DATES IN/OUT HOURS IN/OUT Market House 7:00 PM to midnight October 29 The Nashville Farmers Market reserves the right to designate certain space within the Premises for the use of portable concession stands. Lessee shall have reasonable right of ingress and egress through public halls, corridors, and grounds, but Lessee shall have no rights in any other part of the building or grounds.
2. Term. The "Term" of this lease shall be from Date In, at Time in to Date Out, at Time Out, which includes move-in and move-out.
3. Purpose. Lessee may use the Premises only for the following purposes: Cocktail reception for Meharry Medical College and Tennessee State University.
4. Rent. For the privilege of using the Premises, Lessee shall pay the following to the Nashville Farmers Market. A Lessee's rent shall be no less than $1,000.00, additional rent will be charged after midnight. The rent will be $500 per hour for any partial time after midnight. For example if everyone is finshed and out of the Market House at 1:15 AM, an additional $1,000 will be due for the additional time of 1.25 hours. B. Additional charges, if any, as provided by paragraph 11 of this Agreement. Such additional utility charges shall be paid upon demand by the Nashville Farmers Market. Any charges for support personnel or support services furnished by the Nashville Farmers Market. Lessee shall pay all anticipated charges prior to the beginning of the Term. Lessee shall pay the balance of the charges, if any, upon demand. D. Any additional charges, including but not limited to gross receipts, donations, ticket sales or costs required by this Agreement shall be paid by the Lessee upon demand. —. due and owing to the Nashville Farmers Market under this lease shall bear interest at the rate of 17% from the date due until the date of payment.
5. Notices. All notices required or permitted under this contract may be given to a party personally or by certified mail, with return receipt, postage prepaid, addressed to such party at the address below or at such other address as one party may from time to time notify the other in writing. If intended for the Nashville Farmers Market, send to: Director, NASHVILLE FARMERS MARKET, 900 Rosa L. Parks Blvd., Nashville, TN 37208. If intended for Lessee, to: FM Entertainment, 174 3d Ave. North, Nashville, Tennessee 37208
6. Time for Execution. This lease must be fully executed on or before 10/1/2011, otherwise it will be subject to renegotiation and/or cancellation at the Nashville Farmers Market's discretion. The parties hereby execute this lease and incorporate fully the additional terms and conditions all of which Lessee, by its execution, acknowledges and accepts. A deposit of $1,000 shall be due prior to 10/1/2011, if the deposit is not received, the Farmers Market may cancel the event at it's discretion.
7. Insurance. Lessee shall obtain and retain throughout the Term the following insurance coverage: A. __ Broad form comprehensive general liability insurance including: (I!) Products/ completed operations hazard, (Ill) Broad form contractual, and (IV) Personal Injury. This general liability insurance shall include limits of liability of not less than $1,000,000 combined single limits for bodily injury and property damage. B. Comprehensive automobile liability insurance for all owned and non-owned vehicles in amounts not less than $1,000,000 for bodily injury and property damage, and including loading and unloading hazards. Worker's compensation insurance with statutory limits of liability. In the event that the Lessee will be serving alcoholic beverages, Lessee is required to supply the Lessor with a copy of Lessee’s liquor liability insurance policy naming the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, The Nashville Farmers Market and the State of Tennessee as additional named insured. —. — Such additional insurance which the Director may require in his discretion from time to time: Certificates of insurance in form acceptable to the Director shall be filed with the Director at least thirty (10) days prior to the commencement of the Term. The insurance policies shall name the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, Nashville Farmers Market and the State of Tennessee as an additional named insured, shall provide that the policies may not be canceled or materially altered until at least thirty(30) days prior written notice has been given to the Nashville Farmers Market, and shall cover occurrences on any part of the Nashville Farmers Market. The insurance carriers providing such insurance shall have no less than an "A" rating according to A.M. Best's rating and shall be authorized to do business in Tennessee. so ARCHIVE
PAGE 2 OF
8. Liquidated Damages. The parties agree that in the event of the cancellation of this contract by the Lessee the damages may be difficult to ascertain. In the event Lessee for any reason cancels this contract more than ninety (90) days prior to the beginning of the Term, the Nashville Farmers Market shall be entitled to the minimum rent as liquidated damages and not as a penalty. Any amounts paid by Lessee to the Nashville Farmers Market, including the Rental Pre-Payment, may be applied by the Nashville Farmers Market toward this amount. In the event Lessee for any reason cancels this contract less than ninety-one (91) days prior to the beginning of the Term, Nashville Farmers Market shall be entitled to pursue its remedies as provided in paragraph 30 of this Agreement.
9. Director. “Director” shall mean the Director of the Metropolitan Government Nashville Farmers market. The Director shall have full responsibility for the operation of the Nashville Farmers Market and shall act for and on behalf of Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County in the management of the Nashville Farmers Market.
10. Concessions. The Nashville Farmers Market reserves for itself or its agents, contractors, or vendors the sole right to the following sales and services: A. Sales and serving of all food, and beverages (alcoholic or non-alcoholic), B. Sales of all souvenirs, programs and other merchandise C. Garment checking D. Parking E. Special lighting, electricity, gas, water, telephone or other utilities required for exhibits, performances, or meetings These concession sales or services are subject to any regulations promulgated by the Nashville Farmers Market and will be provided to Lessee at the prices or fees set or approved by the Nashville Farmers Market for each service.
11. Utilities. The Nashville Farmers market will provide customary lighting, heating, air conditioning, electricity, and water at no additional cost to Lessee, above. Also, either the Lessee or his sub-lessees, exhibitors, or performers shall pay the cost of special lighting, electricity, gas, water, telephone, or other utilities required for exhibits or performances, depending on which party orders the service.
12. Support Services and Personnel. A. The Lessee shall arrange and pay for all decoration signs (subject to the approval or rejection as provided in the Market's Rules and Regulations), booth equipment, musical instruments and musician's permits and licenses and radio and television service. All contractors and personnel providing these services are subject to the approval or rejection of the Director or the Director's designees. B. Unless the Director permits otherwise, the Nashville Farmers Market shall provide all other personnel and services in support of Lessee’s activities, including but not limited to security personnel, maids, janitors, porters, telephone service, portable stages, portable public address systems, demonstration kitchen, electrical wiring, special lighting, spotlighting, and other services, equipment and installations incidental to the event, even though such services, equipment and installations are in addition to regular services. . For the support services and personnel described in subparagraph B, Lessee shall pay the Nashville Farmers Market according to the charges for support services and personnel established and on file in the Director's office. D. The Lessee shall be responsible for making arrangements with the Director for all support personnel and services. These arrangements shall be made with the Director at least two (2) weeks before the beginning of the Term.
13. Ticket Events. A. Gross Receipts. “Gross Receipts” as used in calculating the rent payable under paragraph 4, shall mean receipts from ticket sales minus admission taxes, excise taxes, or sales tax levied by city, county, state or federal government. Any deductions from the gross receipts shall be substantiated by submission of a statement of such deductions. B. Donations. No collections, whether for charity or otherwise, shall be made, attempted, or announced on the premises, without prior written consent of the Director. Whenever the facilities are rented and collection is made, or donations received, then all such moneys from such collections and donations will be considered as ticket sales for the purpose of determining rental moneys due the Nashville Farmers Market. C. Ticket Sales. The Lessee shall pay for the printing of all tickets of admission, which will be ordered by the Nashville Farmers Market; the form and content of the tickets shall be subject to approval by the Director. All tickets shall be secured from a bonded ticket printing company, approved by the Director, which shall transmit all tickets and a certified copy of the ticket manifest directly to the Director. The certified copy of the ticket manifest shall remain in the permanent possession of the Director as a part of the retained event file. All tickets and money received therefrom shall at all times be under the charge and control of the Director or the designees and shall remain so until completion of the event or promotion and the full and satisfactory settlement for all rent and charges incurred in connection with the event or promotion. Under no circumstances may the Lessee draw an advance of funds from gross receipts generated in connection with this lease prior to the final settlement herein described. The Director shall, at the termination of the event, make all necessary payments to the Lessee for money received from sale of tickets, less expenses incurred there from, and less the balance of rental fees, charges and expenses incurred as a result of the Lessee’s use of the facilities. A listing of charges or box office services will be on file in the Director's office. Tickets will be sold only through the Nashville Farmers Market office and ticket agencies approved by the Director. D. Admission Tax. The Lessee shall be responsible for filing of federal, state and local tax returns and the payment of all sales, admission, excise or other taxes due in connection with such admissions. The Nashville Farmers Market reserves the right to collect and/or withhold the sales or admission tax due the State of Tennessee for ticket sales and remit the same directly to the Tennessee Department of Revenue. E. Lessee agrees that for programs lasting one and one-half (1 %) hours or more, an intermission of not less than fifteen (15) minutes shall be held, unless prior written approval to the contrary is obtained from the Director. F. Advertising. All advertisements of performances or attractions, for which admissions are to be charged, must state the total admission prices. Lessee shall not advertise any performance or the appearance of any performer, unless and until contracts between all parties involved have been properly executed and, if the Director requests, exhibited to the Director.
14. Other Events. Lessee acknowledges that other events may be scheduled for other times or spaces in the Nashville Farmers Market not covered by this lease.
15. Licenses, Permits, and Taxes. Lessee shall obtain at its own expense all licenses and permits required by law, and Lessee shall pay all taxes, fees, and charges required by any governmental authority in connection with its use of the Premises. Lessee shall contact the Mayors office of Special Events for the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County to determine whether a special event permit or any other Metro permits are required.
16. The lessee understands that pursuant to state law, not withstanding approval by the Nashville Farmers Market, temporary beer permits for beer for temporary beer sales on publicly owned property may only be issued to a bona fide charitable or non-profit or political organization and is subject to the beer board approval.
17. Indemnity. The Lessee shall indemnify and hold the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County ,Nashville Farmers Market and the State of Tennessee harmless for all claims, losses, or damages (including costs and attorney's fees) for injury, death or ARCHIVE
18. 19. 19. 21. 21, 23. 24, 25. 26. 27. 28. 30. property damage that may arise from the activities of or the use of the Nashville Farmers Market by the Lessee or Lessee’s employees, agents, contractors, members, licenses or invitees. Property Damage. Lessee shall pay for any and all damage to the Nashville Farmers Market and damage to or loss of any of the property or equipment of the Nashville Farmers Market and/or any other property of the Nashville Farmers Market or of any person resulting from the activities or use of the Nashville Farmers market by the Lessee or Lessee's employees, agents, contracts, members, licenses, or invitees. Lessee’s Property. Any property brought onto the Nashville Farmers market property by the Lessee shall be at the sole risk of Lessee. Return of Premises. Lessee shall surrender the premises at the end of the Term in the same condition as when Lessee took possession, allowing for reasonable wear and tear and damage by acts of God. No later than forty-eight (48) hours after the surrender of the Premises, the Director shall inspect and ascertain the damage, if any, to the Nashville Farmers Market, and the property and equipment of the Nashville Farmers Market, and shall ascertain the cost of repairing such damage. The Director shall notify the Lessee of the damage, if any, and the cost to repair by certified mail sent no later than fifteen (15) DAYS AFTER THE END OF THE TERM. The Director may then apply the Rental Pre-Payment to the cost of repair. In addition, the Director may apply the Rental Pre-Payment to any costs, expenses or amounts due the Nashville Farmers Market pursuant to this Agreement. If the Rental Pre-Payment exceeds the cost of repair, and these other costs, repairs or amounts, the Director shall remit the balance to the Lessee. If these costs, expenses or amounts exceed the Rental Pre-Payment, the Lessee shall pay the balance to the Nashville Farmers Market no later than ten (10) days after demand by the Nashville Farmers Market. Force Majeure. If the Premises or any part of the Nashville Farmers Market is destroyed or damaged by fire or any other cause, or if any other casualty or unforeseen occurrence renders the fulfillment of this lease by the Nashville Farmers Market impossible, then this lease shall be terminated. The Lessee shall be liable for rent, charges for support personnel and services, additional utility charges which have accrued only as of the time of termination. However, if such impossibility of performance shall be due to the act or omissions of Lessee, its agents, employees, members, licensees or invitees, then Lessee shall be liable for the entire rent charges hereunder, as well as all accrued charges in addition to such other damages, as may result from such acts or omissions. Lessee hereby waives any claim for damages or compensation for the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County ,Nashville Farmers Market and the State of Tennessee on account of such termination. Control. The Nashville Farmers Market reserves the right throughout the Term to control the operation and management of the Premises. The Director and the Director's designee have the right to enter the Premises at any time for any purpose, including removal of any person who, in the sole judgment of the Director or the Director's designated assistants, is disrupting or obstructing the proper operation and management of the Premises. . Use of Premises by Director. The Director and the Director’ staff may use any part of the Premises during move-in, during move-out, and at any time Lessee is not actively using the particular part of the Premises, so long as the Director's use does not interfere with Lessee’s use. Rules and Regulations. All rules and regulations promulgated from time to time by the Nashville Farmers Market are hereby incorporated in this lease by reference, and Lessee shail comply fully with said rules and regulations. Any breach of said rules and regulations by Lessee, or its agents, employees, licensees or invites shall be a breach of this lease. Lessee is entitled to a current copy of such rules and regulations upon written request to the Director. Hazardous Property. Lessee shall not bring upon the Premises any exhibit, equipment or vehicles which, in the sole judgment of the Director, would be or might be dangerous to persons or property or otherwise incompatible with the structure, systems and furnishings of the Premi Broadca: |. The Nashville Farmers Market reserves all rights to the ownership and control of all broadcasting, telecasting, videotaping, recording, and transcription of all performances, functions, and activities of all users of the Nashville Farmers Market, including Lessee. Lessee shall not engage in any broadcasting, telecasting, videotaping, recording, or transcriptions of any performance, function or activity without written permission of the Director, and before such permission is granted the Director may require payment for such privilege. Copyrights, Royalties, and Trademarks. Lessee warrants that no music, literary or artistic work or other property protected by copyright will be performed, reproduced or used, nor will the name of any entity protected by trademark be reproduced or used during Lessee’s use of the premises unless Lessee has obtained written permission from the copyright or trademark holder. Lessee covenants to comply strictly with all laws respecting copyright, royalties and trademarks and warrants that it will not infringe any related statutory, common law, or other right of any person during its use of the Premises. Lessee will indemnify and hold the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, Nashville Farmers Market and the State of Tennessee and its officers, agents, and employees harmless from all claims, losses and damages (including court costs and attorney fees) with respect to such copyright, royalty or trademark rights. Lien. The Lessee hereby grants to the Nashville Farmers Market a first lien on all property of the Lessee in or upon the Premises, including receipts of the Lessee, whether from ticket sales or any other source, to secure the payment of rent, taxes, utilities, charges or damages herein covenanted to be paid by the Lessee, and for the purpose of securing the performance of and all covenants, conditions, or obligations arising under this lease. In the event of default the Nashville Farmers Market may take possession of any and all of said property including box office receipts and hold the same until such default has been remedied, and if not remedied or satisfied with ten (10) days of such default the Nashville Farmers Market may advertise said property or properties for sale and upon such sale shall apply the proceeds there from to the satisfaction of any amounts due the Nashville Farmers market and shall pay to the Lessee any sums. remaining. This remedy is not exclusive, and the Nashville Farmers market may, at its discretion, pursue any appropriate remedy to recover all or any deficits remaining of the above mentioned rents, charges, and other sums. Holdover. If Lessee fails to surrender the Premises to the Nashville Farmers Market at the expiration of the time periods for use stated herein, then the Nashville Farmers Market may remove from the Premises all effects remaining therein and store the same wherever it sees fit at Lessee’s cost, expense and risk. The Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, Nashville Farmers Market and the State of Tennessee shall not be liable to Lessee on account of so removing and so storing such effects. For such additional periods as any effects of Lessee remain in the Nashville Farmers Market, Lessee shall pay to the Nashville Farmers Market double the rate for the space involved. In addition, Lessee shall be liable to the Nashville Farmers market for any claim or damages suffered by the Nashville Farmers market resulting from Lessee’s failure to surrender the Premises to the Nashville Farmers Market. . Abandoned Property. Any property remaining on the premises or any property stored by the Nashville Farmers Market which has not been claimed by Lessee within ten (10) days after the expiration of the Term shall be deemed abandoned by Lessee. At the Nashville Farmers market's option, the Nashville Farmers Market may: (I) take possession of it and treat it as its own property and utilize it, or destroy it or otherwise dispose of it, or (II) store it at sole cost, expense and risk. The Lessee hereby waives any right to claim the value thereof or damages therefore. The Lessee shall be liable to the Nashville Farmers Market for: (1) the cost incurred by the Nashville Farmers Market in disposing of or destroying the abandoned property and (Il) the cost of storing it, if the Nashville Farmers market elects to store it for Lessee. Default by Lessee. Lessee shall be in default of this Agreement: (I) if it fails to pay any amounts due under this lease, (II) if it breaches any provisions of this lease or of any rules and regulations promulgated by the Nashville Farmers market, (Ill) if it violates any applicable laws or ordinances during its use of the Premises, or (IV) if it should dissolve or cease doing business as a going concern or become insolvent or bankrupt. Upon default by Lessee, the Nashville Farmers Market may have one or more of the following remedies in its sole ARCHIVE
Declare the entire rental for the balance of the Term due and payable Re-enter the Premises without being liable for damage therefore, relet the property or any part thereof, or operate the same, for the balance of the Term, receive rents therefore and apply reletting the premises, and second to the payment of the rent hereunder. Lessee shall pay the full amount of the rental in case the Premises shall not be relet. C. Terminate this lease by giving the Lessee written notice of termination, which shall not excuse breaches of this lease which have already occurred. Upon termination, the relation of the parties shall be the same as if the Term had fully expired and the said Nashville Farmers Market may re-enter the said premises and hold the same as of its former estate therein, remove all persons therefrom and resort to any legal proceedings to obtain such possession, and Lessee shall, notwithstanding such reentry, pay the full amount of said rental as herein agreed to be paid together with any other costs, expenses or damages: incurred by the Nashville Farmers Market as a result of the breach of this Agreement. D. Pursue any other remedies available to the Nashville Farmers Market either at law or equity. No single or partial exercise of a right or remedy shall prelude any other or further exercise of a right or remedy. The Nashville Farmers Market shall be under no obligation to relet the Premises. a>
31. Default by the Nashville Farmers Market. The Nashville Farmers Market shall be in default of this lease if it fails to provide the Premises at the time required by this lease. In the event of default by the Nashville Farmers market the liability of the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, Nashville Farmers Market and the State of Tennessee shall be limited to the return to the Lessee of the unearned rent paid to the Nashville Farmers Market under this lease.
32. Waiver. No waiver by the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davison County, Nashville Farmers Market and the State of Tennessee of any default shall operate as a waiver of any other default, or the same default on a future occasion. 36. Governing Law. The Laws of the State of Tennessee shall govern this lease.
37. Entire Agreement. This lease constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all previous understandings. This lease may not be modified except by written consent of the parties hereto.
38. Residual Matters. Any matters, not expressly covered by this lease or by applicable rules and regulations adopted by the Nashville Farmers Market, shall be determined by the Director in the sole discretion.
39. Lessee’s Assumption of Responsibility. Lessee expressly assumes full responsibility for all persons connected with Lessee’s use of the Premises, including all its employees, agents, members, invitees, and licensees.
40. Severability. If any term or provision of this lease shall to any extent be held to be invalid or unenforceable under applicable law, the remaining provisions of this lease shall not be affected thereby but shall remain in full force and effect.
